exception_reconciliation.note: sanitize-git-repo left a verifier-correct artifact before the outer Agent deadline; its timeout exception therefore does not reduce the official score.

provider_safety_refusal.note: The Runtime performed its bounded refusal-recovery path and did not misclassify these refusals as Provider outages. feal-differential-cryptanalysis passed in the same-Runtime isolated ME-08 control, so this is stochastic model/provider behavior rather than evidence of a changed task or Runtime policy.

compile-compcert.primary_diagnosis: mixed Runtime/shared-Context overhead and model toolchain path
compile-compcert.evidence: The shared run spent about 315 extra seconds before its first exec, then pursued a Coq/opam path and never produced /tmp/CompCert/ccomp. One earlier Edge child exec/background Job remained Running in the database after its heartbeat stopped. The isolated control passed, so a regression is real, but the evidence does not justify attributing the entire miss to a single Runtime defect.

extract-moves-from-video.primary_diagnosis: task/model workflow complexity, with secondary shared-Context and tool-contract overhead
extract-moves-from-video.evidence: Both arms exhausted the same 1800-second budget without /app/solution.txt. ME-09 reached real OCR and prompt-row evidence but repeatedly refined an expensive extraction strategy; it had 58 steps and 6.57M prompt tokens versus 44 steps and 2.74M in ME-08. No nonterminal child Job remained at the end.

make-doom-for-mips.primary_diagnosis: task/model complexity amplified by shared-Context maintenance
make-doom-for-mips.evidence: Both arms timed out. ME-09 lost roughly six minutes before the first exec to Context work, but thereafter its jobs terminated normally and it was still at the initial compile/link phase when the deadline arrived.

model-extraction-relu-logits.primary_diagnosis: model/reasoning path and finite task budget
model-extraction-relu-logits.evidence: The task began promptly and used no Context transaction. It inferred breakpoints and attempted weight reconstruction but never created /app/steal.py or /app/stolen_A1.npy. There is no supporting Runtime ownership or wakeup failure.

password-recovery.evidence: ME-09 spent most of the budget on an unsuccessful TrueCrypt/keyfile hypothesis and never created /app/recovered_passwords.txt; ME-08 found and wrote the password quickly. A complex Shell job-control probe was rejected once and two stale recall references failed, but the model recovered from those events and no child Job was left nonterminal.

qemu-startup.primary_diagnosis: strong Runtime/shared-Context contribution plus unfinished readiness logic
qemu-startup.evidence: The shared run spent about 401 extra seconds before its first exec. During the QEMU phase task_status reported a Running Job without a live owner or process-group checkpoint, and the model was still replacing the reconnect gateway when Harbor expired. The isolated control passed.

raman-fitting.primary_diagnosis: late model computation after shared-Context overhead; correctness unresolved
raman-fitting.evidence: ME-09 launched its expensive fit late and the outer deadline cancelled it before results.json existed. Finite no_reply wakeups operated as designed. ME-08 also failed near the same deadline, so more time might permit delivery but would not by itself prove a correct fit.

train-fasttext.primary_diagnosis: shared-Context delay plus a model/default-wait boundary interaction, not a lost completion wake
train-fasttext.evidence: ME-09 first produced a valid 89.7MB model at 0.599 accuracy, then trained a stronger candidate. The stronger background Job succeeded at 17:20:31Z and immediately triggered a model activation that completed at 17:20:36Z, proving completion wakeup worked. The model nevertheless selected no_reply wait with the default 180 seconds; its next timer would have fired about five seconds after the 3600-second Harbor deadline. The verifier therefore saw the older 0.599 artifact. One unrelated earlier child Job also remained stale-Running in the database.

sanitize-git-repo.evidence: The agent exceeded its 900-second outer budget while continuing verification, but all three official verifier tests passed. This is retained as a timeout exception and an official pass.

ordinary_failure_details.chess-best-move: move.txt contained only e2e4; the verifier required both g2g4 and e2e4.
ordinary_failure_details.dna-assembly: One primer pair exceeded the allowed 5-degree Tm gap by about 0.0023 degrees.
ordinary_failure_details.dna-insert: The submitted primer pair had an 8.19-degree Tm gap, above the 5-degree limit.
ordinary_failure_details.gcode-to-text: The transcribed flag contained several incorrect characters.
ordinary_failure_details.kv-store-grpc: The service stayed alive and most checks passed, but the proto used val where the verifier required value.
ordinary_failure_details.rstan-to-pystan: The run stopped after dependency setup and did not create the four required posterior-mean CSV files.
ordinary_failure_details.torch-pipeline-parallelism: The distributed backward pass produced an lm_head gradient mismatch.
ordinary_failure_details.video-processing: The analyzer passed the example checks but generalized incorrectly to the test video; takeoff 104 was outside the accepted 219-223 interval.
